description:
Report your source IP as Autonet sees it, with cached approximate ASN/geo when available.
    No signup or target needed for the first 10 shared completed interactive work calls/IP/24h; then 1 credit with utility_api_key, request_key and max_coins. Reuse request_key on retry.
    60 requests/IP/minute; hosted MCP transport quota also applies.
    May identify a NAT, VPN, proxy or hosted MCP runner, not your device. Does not probe inbound
    reachability or reveal Autonet's probe egress. Missing/stale attribution is explicit.
name: network_identity
